metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 30 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: I need to find daily maximum air temperature at 2 meters for Boston, MA between January 29 and February 5, 2019. ERA5-Land or MERRA-2 reanalysis datasets provide this data. ERA5-Land has daily maximum temperature at 2m (temperature_2m_max). 2. **Masking Strategy**: No cloud masking needed; these are reanalysis temperature data (gridded values, not satellite imagery). 3. **Logic**: - Extract daily max temperatures for the date range in Boston - Find the maximum and minimum temperatures across the period - Calculate the difference - If difference ≥ 30°C, answer A (Yes) - If difference < 30°C, answer B (No) - If data is missing or calculation fails, output C1/C3 Boston coordinates: approximately 42.36°N, 71.06°W ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Boston, MA coordinates const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.06, 42.36]); // Date range: January 29 - February 5, 2019 const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-05'; // Load ERA5-Land daily temperature data const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('temperature_2m_max'); // Daily max temperature at 2m in Kelvin // Check if collection has data const colSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5-Land images in period: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No ERA5-Land data found for date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Extract temperature values at Boston location for each day const tempCollection = era5.map(function(img) { const temp = img.sample(boston, 11132).first().get('temperature_2m_max'); return ee.Feature(null, {'temp_k': temp, 'date': img.get('system:index')}); }); // Get all temperature values const temps = tempCollection.aggregate_array('temp_k').getInfo(); console.log(`Temperatures retrieved: ${temps.length}`); if (temps.length === 0) { console.log('No valid temperature samples extracted.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius and filter out nulls const tempsCelsius = temps .filter(t => t !== null) .map(t => t - 273.15); console.log(`Valid temp samples: ${tempsCelsius.length}`); if (tempsCelsius.length === 0) { console.log('No valid temperature values after filtering.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Find max and min temperatures const maxTemp = Math.max(...tempsCelsius); const minTemp = Math.min(...tempsCelsius); const tempDiff = maxTemp - minTemp; // Validate results if (isNaN(maxTemp) || isNaN(minTemp) || isNaN(tempDiff)) { console.log('Temperature calculation resulted in NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Max temp: ${maxTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Min temp: ${minTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${tempDiff.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Answer the question: Is there at least 30°C difference? if (tempDiff >= 30) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
